description: M/of Mahaweli, Agriculture, Irrigation & Rural Dept. - 2nd Amendment to the Service Minute of the Sir Lanka Animal Production and Health Service
reasoning: This gazette content pertains to amendments to the Service Minute of the Sri Lanka Animal Production and Health Service, specifically detailing qualifications, service periods, and performance appraisal procedures for promotions within a public service.
